title: How can I track my child’s progress after starting occupational therapy?
metaTitle: Tracking Your Child’s Progress in Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how our therapists provide regular updates and progress reports to parents and engage in parent-therapist meetings to discuss children's progress in occupational therapy. Discover how our family-centered approach ensures effective tracking of child's progress.
html: Our therapists provide regular updates and progress reports to parents. Furthermore, parent-therapist meetings to discuss the child's progress and future strategies are an integral part of our family-centered approach.
